title: NoamDoronMath worksheets catalog contract v1
description: Machine-readable worksheet catalog derived from index.html. index.html remains the authoritative live source of truth. This schema documents the generated contract for a future Headless (e.g. Next.js) frontend. Do not treat Wix CMS as source of truth.

contractVersion.description: Required. Contract major version. Bump only with intentional breaking shape changes.

path.description: Required. Live catalog SoT path in this repository.

authoritative.description: Required. Always true while production still serves index.html.

note.description: Optional. Human guidance — not consumed by runtime.

pdfBase.description: Required. Generated from index.html BASE. Full PDF URL = pdfBase + pdfId + '.pdf'. Do not expand to hundreds of full URLs in this file.

levels.description: Required. Default level labels/classes from LEVELS (a/b/c).

oneLabel.description: Required. Default label when links.one is used and links.oneLabel is absent (from levelLinksHTML).

middleGrades.description: Required. From MIDDLE. Viewer routing applies only when grade is in this set AND a Noam prefix resolves.

gradeNames.description: Required. From GRADE_NAME. Keys are grade numbers as strings.

trackGroups.description: Required. Group keys from TRACK_GROUPS that belong to grade-9 reduced program (מסלול מצומצם).

noamPrefixFallback.description: Required. From NOAM_PREFIX_FALLBACK. grade → topicId → prefix string. Used when topic.x is absent.

icons.description: Required. From ICONS. Map of icon key → SVG path markup (inner content for 24×24 viewBox). Topics reference keys only via topic.icon.

searchTerms.description: Required. From SEARCH_TERMS. grade → topicId → space-separated hidden search terms. Legacy/search-specific; preserve for search parity.

grades.description: Required. One entry per DATA grade, ascending. Topic/group array order matches index.html display order.

reducedProgram.description: Required. Derived: true when key ∈ config.trackGroups (grade-9 reduced track).

id.description: Required. From topics[].id. Unique within a grade.

note.description: Optional. From topics[].n when present (supported by cardHTML; may be absent in current DATA).

group.description: Required. From topics[].g — must exist in the same grade's groups.

icon.description: Required. From topics[].ic — must exist in icons.

parent.description: Optional. From topics[].parent — child worksheet bundled under parent card.

noamTopicId.description: Optional. From topics[].x when present. Explicit Noam AI topic id (also drives the catalog AI hint badge).

levels.description: Required. Worksheet levels with Wix Media PDF ids (not full URLs).

routing.description: Required. Derived sheetHref facts — do not invent URLs; combine with config.pdfBase / config.viewer.

label.description: Required. Display label (topic.*Label, link.oneLabel, or defaults).

pdfId.description: Required. Wix Media 32-hex id from DATA.links. Never rewrite.

routing.description: Derived. Mirrors index.html noamTopicPrefix + sheetHref gating. Generated — not a DATA field.

resolvedNoamPrefix.description: topic.x if set, else config.noamPrefixFallback[grade][id], else null.

aiHintShown.description: True only when topics[].x is set (matches cardHTML AI badge).

usesViewer.description: True when VIEWER.enabled AND resolvedNoamPrefix AND grade ∈ middleGrades (matches sheetHref).

viewerPath.description: config.viewer.path when usesViewer, else null (caller should use pdfBase+pdfId+'.pdf').

siblingPdfQuery.description: When usesViewer, optional pa/pb/pc query values from the topic's a/b/c link row (sheetHref sibling params). Empty object otherwise.

generated-derived: stable key ordering in serialized JSON
x-field-classification.sheetHref-recipe: If routing.usesViewer: viewerPath + ?g&x=resolvedNoamPrefix&lv=level.key&pdf=level.pdfId&t=title + siblingPdfQuery. Else: config.pdfBase + level.pdfId + '.pdf'.
